entities.summary:
Tel Aviv University (TAU), founded in 1956, is a major Israeli public research university based in Tel Aviv and one of the country’s largest higher-education institutions. It grew with the city’s expansion into a comprehensive university covering sciences, humanities, law, and medicine.

TAU research and alumni networks linked Israeli high-tech, security studies, and cultural production to global academe. Campus politics reflected wider Israeli debates over occupation, liberalism, and academic boycotts.

As an institution, TAU embodies postwar Israeli urban academic modernity on the Mediterranean coastal plain.
